verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's fraud-prevention docs include a section on creating risk rules and lists and on retrieving fraud reports, and the testing docs list fraud-detection testing. That covers the custom-rules half of the story, but only as page titles with no detail. Nothing in the pack describes machine-learning fraud scoring, so the ML half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of ML fraud scores, explicit block/review/allow rule actions, rule-builder detail beyond a page title, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
